captured_turns.narration:
You drive a fist into Quintus’s jaw. He staggers back a half-step, his grip failing as the gladius slips toward his hip; the pilum clatters away on the stones.

Spittle and blood mark his lip. He wrenches himself upright, eyes narrowed, reaches for his sword with his free hand, then closes in to grab your wrist, drives a knee to disrupt your stance, and shouts to raise the alarm.

captured_turns.narration:
You drive your foot down on Quintus’s foot. His jaw is still injured, and the blow to his ankle makes him wince as he shifts his weight.

He keeps the pilum low but ready, then surges forward with a short, forceful shove to break your advance and keep you outside reach. “Back—now. No more.”

dialogue.response: You drive your foot down. I feel it bite through the mail at my ankle—my leg jolts, balance goes, and I grit my teeth as I stumble in place. My hand scrabbles for the pilum on the ground, but the pain slows me. [STATUS: Injured jaw; stunned and weapon grip disrupted, pilum knocked away; newly injured ankle/foot from stomp]

I surge forward despite the throbbing in my ankle, trying to close before you get space. With my gladius hand steadier than my pilum hand, I snap a short, vicious butt-swing at your ribs to keep you off balance—then shove you back hard with my shoulder as you recoil, boots scraping for traction.

captured_turns.narration:
You drive a knee into Quintus’s ribs. He folds with a strangled gasp, his gladius arm going loose and his pilum hand failing to find purchase. He sags against the gate stones, breathing hard through the pain.

Breathing through clenched teeth, Quintus staggers a half-step and snaps his pilum up, driving the butt into the stone to steady himself. He says, “You’re not passing. Keep back—now.” He shifts his stance to the gate line, ready to jab or shove if you surge again.

dialogue.response: I try to catch your rush with a shove, but you’re in too close. Your knee slams my ribs—air detonates out of me. I fold with a strangled gasp, gladius arm going loose; my pilum hand can’t find purchase, and I sag against the gate stones, breathing hard through the pain. [STATUS: Badly hurt ribs; wind knocked out, control of weapons compromised]
